-- ============================================================
--   ScrollMenu  v7  |  RMB Aimbot  |  Fly Others  |  Fixed
-- ============================================================
local Players     = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS         = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService  = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenSvc    = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting    = game:GetService("Lighting")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local Items       = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Marketplace = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")

local lp    = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = lp:GetMouse()
local cam   = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ─── Colors ────────────────────────────────────────────────
local CB  = Color3.fromRGB(28 ,28 ,28 )
local CS  = Color3.fromRGB(20 ,20 ,20 )
local CT  = Color3.fromRGB(15 ,15 ,15 )
local CI  = Color3.fromRGB(40 ,40 ,40 )
local CD  = Color3.fromRGB(50 ,50 ,50 )
local CA  = Color3.fromRGB(65 ,115,255)
local CG  = Color3.fromRGB(48 ,209,88 )
local CR  = Color3.fromRGB(220,50 ,50 )
local CW  = Color3.fromRGB(235,235,235)
local CQ  = Color3.fromRGB(110,110,110)
local CSL = Color3.fromRGB(32 ,32 ,58 )

-- ─── Sizes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
local WW,WH = 580,440
local SW     = 145
local TH     = 38
local RH     = 46
local SHH    = 58
local GH     = 22
local IP     = 6
local PP     = 10

-- ─── State vars (all at top scope) ─────────────────────────
local flySpd   = 65;  local walkSpd  = 16;  local jumpPwr = 50
local aimFov   = 150; local aimSmooth= 0.85; local aimPred = 0.08; local aimMaxD = 500
local aimbotOn = false; local silentOn = false; local lockOnOn = false
local skipTeamAim=false; local visOnly=false; local aimbotBone="Head"
local lockTgt  = nil;  local myRoot  = nil
local espClr   = Color3.fromRGB(255,50,50)
local espOn    = false; local espRMBOnly=true
local espName  = true;  local espInfo=true; local espHP=true; local espTeam=false
local espDrws  = {}

local flyOn=false; local ncOn=false; local godOn=false; local infJump=false
local invisOn=false; local spinOn=false; local bhopOn=false; local afkOn=false
local flyOthersAll=false; local flyOthersSet={}
local frozenMap={}; local spamKMap={}; local spamKConns={}
local clickTPOn=false; local fbOn=false; local fogOn=false; local hitboxOn=false
local flyConn,flyBV,flyBG,ncConn,godConn,godHConn,spinConn,bhopConn,afkConn

local selPlayer = nil

-- ============================================================
-- FEATURE FUNCTIONS  (defined first so callbacks can use them)
-- ============================================================
-- ── Network ownership helper ────────────────────────────────
-- Claiming ownership lets our client's property changes replicate
local function claimOwner(part)
    pcall(function() part:SetNetworkOwner(lp) end)
    -- some executors expose this as a global
    pcall(function() if setnetworkowner then setnetworkowner(part, lp) end end)
end

local function killChar(ch)
    if not ch then return end
    local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum  = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    -- Claim ownership so our edits replicate in FE games
    if root then
        claimOwner(root)
        for _, p in pairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() claimOwner(p) end) end
        end
    end

    -- Method 1: standard health = 0
    pcall(function()
        if hum then hum.Health = 0; hum:TakeDamage(math.huge) end
    end)

    -- Method 2: sethiddenproperty (available in many executors — bypasses FE)
    pcall(function()
        if hum and sethiddenproperty then
            sethiddenproperty(hum, "Health", 0)
        end
    end)

    -- Method 3: BreakJoints
    pcall(function() ch:BreakJoints() end)

    -- Method 4: void teleport — triggers game's own kill plane server-side
    pcall(function()
        if root then root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, -9999, root.Position.Z) end
    end)

    -- Method 5: extreme downward velocity to punch through kill plane fast
    pcall(function()
        if root then root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -9999, 0) end
    end)
end

local function flingChar(ch)
    if not ch then return end
    local r=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
    local fv=Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    fv.Velocity=Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1)*900,700,math.random(-1,1)*900)
    fv.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9); fv.Parent=r
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(fv,0.15)
end

local function startFly()
    local ch=lp.Character; if not ch then return end
    local r=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local h=ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not r or not h then return end; h.PlatformStand=true
    flyBV=Instance.new("BodyVelocity"); flyBV.Velocity=Vector3.zero; flyBV.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9); flyBV.Parent=r
    flyBG=Instance.new("BodyGyro"); flyBG.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9); flyBG.P=1e4; flyBG.CFrame=r.CFrame; flyBG.Parent=r
    flyConn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local rr=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not rr then return end
        local cf=cam.CFrame; local d=Vector3.zero
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then d=d+cf.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then d=d-cf.LookVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then d=d-cf.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then d=d+cf.RightVector end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then d=d+Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then d=d-Vector3.new(0,1,0) end
        flyBV.Velocity=d.Magnitude>0 and d.Unit*flySpd or Vector3.zero; flyBG.CFrame=cf
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn=nil end
    if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy(); flyBV=nil end
    if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy(); flyBG=nil end
    local h=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if h then h.PlatformStand=false end
end

local function startGod()
    local function applyG(ch)
        local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if not h then return end
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false) end)
        if godHConn then godHConn:Disconnect() end
        godHConn=h.HealthChanged:Connect(function() if godOn then h.Health=h.MaxHealth end end)
        h.Health=h.MaxHealth
    end
    applyG(lp.Character)
    lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) if godOn then task.wait(0.1); applyG(c) end end)
    godConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local h=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h then if h.Health<h.MaxHealth then h.Health=h.MaxHealth end
            pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,false) end) end
    end)
end

local function stopGod()
    if godConn then godConn:Disconnect(); godConn=nil end
    if godHConn then godHConn:Disconnect(); godHConn=nil end
    local h=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if h then pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead,true) end) end
end

local function applyInvis(s)
    local ch=lp.Character; if not ch then return end
    for _,p in pairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" then p.Transparency=s and 1 or 0 end
        if p:IsA("Decal") then p.Transparency=s and 1 or 0 end
    end
end

-- fly a specific other player (toggleable)
local function toggleFlyOther(p)
    if not p then return end
    if flyOthersSet[p] then
        flyOthersSet[p]=nil
        pcall(function()
            local r=p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
            local bv=r:FindFirstChild("_OFBV"); if bv then bv:Destroy() end
            local h=p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if h then h.PlatformStand=false end
        end)
        return false
    else
        flyOthersSet[p]=true
        return true
    end
end

-- persist fly on others every heartbeat
-- Combines ownership claim + raw velocity + BodyVelocity for maximum FE compatibility
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    -- ── per-target fly ──────────────────────────────────────
    for p, _ in pairs(flyOthersSet) do
        pcall(function()
            local ch  = p.Character; if not ch then return end
            local r   = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
            local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            -- Claim network ownership so our velocity changes replicate
            claimOwner(r)

            -- Disable humanoid states that fight upward movement
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = true
                pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false) end)
                pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed,      false) end)
            end

            -- Raw velocity (set every frame — fights server corrections)
            local cur = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(cur.X, 50, cur.Z)

            -- BodyVelocity fallback
            local bv = r:FindFirstChild("_OFBV")
            if not bv then
                bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity"); bv.Name = "_OFBV"
                bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 1e9, 0); bv.Parent = r
            end
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
        end)
    end

    -- ── fly all toggle ──────────────────────────────────────
    if flyOthersAll then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= lp then
                pcall(function()
                    local ch  = p.Character; if not ch then return end
                    local r   = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
                    local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    claimOwner(r)

                    if hum then
                        hum.PlatformStand = true
                        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false) end)
                        pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed,      false) end)
                    end

                    local cur = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(cur.X, 50, cur.Z)

                    local bv = r:FindFirstChild("_OFBV")
                    if not bv then
                        bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity"); bv.Name = "_OFBV"
                        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(0, 1e9, 0); bv.Parent = r
                    end
                    bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 50, 0)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    -- ── freeze persistence ──────────────────────────────────
    for p, frz in pairs(frozenMap) do
        if frz then pcall(function()
            local r = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if r then
                claimOwner(r)
                if not r.Anchored then r.Anchored = true end
            end
        end) end
    end
end)

lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
    if flyOn then task.wait(0.5); startFly() end
    if invisOn then task.wait(0.5); applyInvis(true) end
    local h=ch:WaitForChild("Humanoid",5)
    if h then h.WalkSpeed=walkSpd; h.JumpPower=jumpPwr end
end)

UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if not infJump then return end
    local h=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
end)

mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
    if not clickTPOn then return end
    local r=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if mouse.Hit and r then r.CFrame=mouse.Hit+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- GUI
-- ============================================================
local SG=Instance.new("ScreenGui"); SG.Name="ScrollMenuV7"
SG.ResetOnSpawn=false; SG.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling; SG.Parent=game:GetService("CoreGui")

local Main=Instance.new("Frame"); Main.Size=UDim2.new(0,WW,0,WH)
Main.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-WW/2,.5,-WH/2); Main.BackgroundColor3=CB
Main.BorderSizePixel=0; Main.Parent=SG
Instance.new("UICorner",Main).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)
local mstroke=Instance.new("UIStroke",Main); mstroke.Color=CD; mstroke.Thickness=1; mstroke.Transparency=0.5

-- title bar
local TB=Instance.new("Frame"); TB.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,TH); TB.BackgroundColor3=CT
TB.BorderSizePixel=0; TB.Parent=Main; Instance.new("UICorner",TB).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)

local TLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); TLbl.Text="ScrollMenu  |  v7"
TLbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; TLbl.TextSize=14; TLbl.TextColor3=CW
TLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; TLbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,1,0); TLbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,14,0,0)
TLbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; TLbl.Parent=TB

local function mkTB2(txt,xOff,bg,fg)
    local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Text=txt; b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; b.TextSize=13
    b.TextColor3=fg; b.BackgroundColor3=bg; b.Size=UDim2.new(0,26,0,26)
    b.Position=UDim2.new(1,xOff,0,6); b.BorderSizePixel=0; b.AutoButtonColor=false; b.Parent=TB
    Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5); return b
end
local CloseBtn=mkTB2("✕",-32,Color3.fromRGB(140,20,20),Color3.fromRGB(255,150,150))
local MinBtn  =mkTB2("─",-62,Color3.fromRGB(35,35,60), Color3.fromRGB(160,160,255))

-- drag
local drag,dSt,dPos
TB.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag,dSt,dPos=true,i.Position,Main.Position end end)
TB.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag=false end end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if drag and i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local d=i.Position-dSt; Main.Position=UDim2.new(dPos.X.Scale,dPos.X.Offset+d.X,dPos.Y.Scale,dPos.Y.Offset+d.Y)
    end
end)

-- sidebar
local Side=Instance.new("Frame"); Side.Size=UDim2.new(0,SW,0,WH-TH)
Side.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,TH); Side.BackgroundColor3=CS; Side.BorderSizePixel=0; Side.Parent=Main
local sdiv=Instance.new("Frame"); sdiv.Size=UDim2.new(0,1,0,WH-TH); sdiv.Position=UDim2.new(0,SW,0,TH)
sdiv.BackgroundColor3=CD; sdiv.BorderSizePixel=0; sdiv.Parent=Main

local PTagLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); PTagLbl.Text="  👤  "..lp.Name
PTagLbl.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; PTagLbl.TextSize=11; PTagLbl.TextColor3=CQ
PTagLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; PTagLbl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32); PTagLbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-32)
PTagLbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; PTagLbl.Parent=Side

-- content
local ConF=Instance.new("Frame"); ConF.Size=UDim2.new(0,WW-SW-1,0,WH-TH)
ConF.Position=UDim2.new(0,SW+1,0,TH); ConF.BackgroundColor3=CB; ConF.BorderSizePixel=0; ConF.Parent=Main

local ConScroll=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame"); ConScroll.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
ConScroll.BackgroundTransparency=1; ConScroll.BorderSizePixel=0; ConScroll.ScrollBarThickness=4
ConScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(55,55,80); ConScroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,400)
ConScroll.Parent=ConF

-- ============================================================
-- TAB SYSTEM
-- ============================================================
local pages   = {}   -- id → {frame, h}
local tabBtns2 = {}  -- id → button
local tabY2   = 8
local activeTab = nil

local function switchTab(id)
    for tid,pg in pairs(pages) do pg.frame.Visible=(tid==id) end
    if pages[id] then ConScroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.new(0,0,0,pages[id].h); ConScroll.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,0) end
    for tid,btn in pairs(tabBtns2) do
        btn.BackgroundColor3=tid==id and CSL or CS
        btn.TextColor3=tid==id and CW or CQ
    end
    activeTab=id
end

local function mkTabBtn(id,icon,name)
    local btn=Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Text="  "..icon.."  "..name
    btn.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; btn.TextSize=13; btn.TextColor3=CQ
    btn.BackgroundColor3=CS; btn.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42)
    btn.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,0,tabY2); btn.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.BorderSizePixel=0; btn.AutoButtonColor=false; btn.Parent=Side
    Instance.new("UICorner",btn).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
    tabBtns2[id]=btn; tabY2=tabY2+44
    local pg=Instance.new("Frame"); pg.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,400)
    pg.BackgroundTransparency=1; pg.Visible=false; pg.Parent=ConScroll
    pages[id]={frame=pg,h=400}
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab(id) end)
    return pg
end

-- ============================================================
-- ITEM HELPERS
-- ============================================================
local function mkSec2(par,y,txt)
    local l=Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.Text=txt:upper()
    l.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; l.TextSize=10; l.TextColor3=CQ; l.BackgroundTransparency=1
    l.Size=UDim2.new(1,-PP*2,0,GH); l.Position=UDim2.new(0,PP,0,y[1])
    l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; l.Parent=par
    y[1]=y[1]+GH+4
end

local function baseRow(par,y)
    local r=Instance.new("Frame"); r.Size=UDim2.new(1,-PP*2,0,RH)
    r.Position=UDim2.new(0,PP,0,y[1]); r.BackgroundColor3=CI; r.BorderSizePixel=0; r.Parent=par
    Instance.new("UICorner",r).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7)
    y[1]=y[1]+RH+IP; return r
end

-- toggle row — returns setter fn
local function mkTog2(par,y,lTxt,sTxt,init,cb)
    local r=baseRow(par,y)
    local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Text=lTxt; lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; lbl.TextSize=13
    lbl.TextColor3=CW; lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    lbl.Size=UDim2.new(0.6,0,sTxt and 0.55 or 1,0); lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,0)
    lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.Parent=r
    if sTxt then
        local s=Instance.new("TextLabel"); s.Text=sTxt; s.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; s.TextSize=10
        s.TextColor3=CQ; s.BackgroundTransparency=1; s.Size=UDim2.new(0.6,0,0.45,0)
        s.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0.55,0); s.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; s.Parent=r
    end
    local TW2,TH2=46,26; local KS=TH2-4
    local track=Instance.new("Frame"); track.Size=UDim2.new(0,TW2,0,TH2)
    track.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(TW2+10),0.5,-TH2/2); track.BorderSizePixel=0; track.Parent=r
    track.BackgroundColor3=init and CG or Color3.fromRGB(58,58,58)
    Instance.new("UICorner",track).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local kn=Instance.new("Frame"); kn.Size=UDim2.new(0,KS,0,KS); kn.BackgroundColor3=CW
    kn.BorderSizePixel=0; kn.Parent=track
    kn.Position=init and UDim2.new(1,-(KS+2),0.5,-KS/2) or UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,-KS/2)
    Instance.new("UICorner",kn).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local hit=Instance.new("TextButton"); hit.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency=1; hit.Text=""; hit.Parent=r
    local st=init
    hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        st=not st
        TweenSvc:Create(track,TweenInfo.new(0.15),{BackgroundColor3=st and CG or Color3.fromRGB(58,58,58)}):Play()
        TweenSvc:Create(kn,TweenInfo.new(0.15),{Position=st and UDim2.new(1,-(KS+2),0.5,-KS/2) or UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,-KS/2)}):Play()
        cb(st)
    end)
    return function(ns)
        st=ns; track.BackgroundColor3=ns and CG or Color3.fromRGB(58,58,58)
        kn.Position=ns and UDim2.new(1,-(KS+2),0.5,-KS/2) or UDim2.new(0,2,0.5,-KS/2)
    end
end

-- action row — button on right, returns button
local function mkAct2(par,y,lTxt,sTxt,btnTxt,btnCol,cb)
    btnCol=btnCol or CA; local r=baseRow(par,y)
    local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Text=lTxt; lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; lbl.TextSize=13
    lbl.TextColor3=CW; lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    lbl.Size=UDim2.new(0.55,0,sTxt and 0.55 or 1,0); lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,0)
    lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.Parent=r
    if sTxt then
        local s=Instance.new("TextLabel"); s.Text=sTxt; s.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham; s.TextSize=10
        s.TextColor3=CQ; s.BackgroundTransparency=1; s.Size=UDim2.new(0.55,0,0.45,0)
        s.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0.55,0); s.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; s.Parent=r
    end
    local BW,BH=78,28
    local btn=Instance.new("TextButton"); btn.Text=btnTxt; btn.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; btn.TextSize=11
    btn.TextColor3=CW; btn.BackgroundColor3=btnCol; btn.Size=UDim2.new(0,BW,0,BH)
    btn.Position=UDim2.new(1,-(BW+10),0.5,-BH/2); btn.BorderSizePixel=0; btn.AutoButtonColor=false; btn.Parent=r
    Instance.new("UICorner",btn).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenSvc:Create(btn,TweenInfo.new(0.1),{BackgroundColor3=btnCol:lerp(CW,0.18)}):Play() end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenSvc:Create(btn,TweenInfo.new(0.1),{BackgroundColor3=btnCol}):Play() end)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(cb); return btn
end

-- slider row — returns setter fn
local function mkSld2(par,y,lTxt,mn,mx,def,dec,unit,cb)
    unit=unit or""; dec=dec or 0
    local r=Instance.new("Frame"); r.Size=UDim2.new(1,-PP*2,0,SHH)
    r.Position=UDim2.new(0,PP,0,y[1]); r.BackgroundColor3=CI; r.BorderSizePixel=0; r.Parent=par
    Instance.new("UICorner",r).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,7)
    local lbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); lbl.Text=lTxt; lbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; lbl.TextSize=12
    lbl.TextColor3=CW; lbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; lbl.Size=UDim2.new(0.62,0,0,22)
    lbl.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,0,9); lbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; lbl.Parent=r
    local vLbl=Instance.new("TextLabel"); vLbl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; vLbl.TextSize=12
    vLbl.TextColor3=CA; vLbl.BackgroundTransparency=1; vLbl.Size=UDim2.new(0.34,0,0,22)
    vLbl.Position=UDim2.new(0.66,-12,0,9); vLbl.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right; vLbl.Parent=r

local function scrCtr() return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X/2,cam.ViewportSize.Y/2) end
local function isAimEnemy(p) if not skipTeamAim then return true end; if not lp.Team or not p.Team then return true end; return lp.Team~=p.Team end

local function canSee(pos)
    local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterDescendantsInstances={lp.Character or workspace}; params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local res=workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position,pos-cam.CFrame.Position,params); if not res then return true end

local function predictPos(root,part)
    if aimPred<=0 then return part.Position end
    local ok,vel=pcall(function() return root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
    return part.Position+(ok and vel or Vector3.zero)*aimPred
end

local function isStillValid(p)
    if not p or not p.Character then return false end
    local ch=p.Character; local h=ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local pt=ch:FindFirstChild(aimbotBone) or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local rt=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not pt or not h or h.Health<=0 or not isAimEnemy(p) then return false end
    if rt and myRoot and (rt.Position-myRoot.Position).Magnitude>aimMaxD then return false end
    local sp,on=cam:WorldToScreenPoint(pt.Position)
    return on and (Vector2.new(sp.X,sp.Y)-scrCtr()).Magnitude<aimFov*2
end

local function getBestTarget()
    if lockOnOn and lockTgt and isStillValid(lockTgt) then return lockTgt end; lockTgt=nil
    local ctr=scrCtr(); local bestD=aimFov; local bestP=nil
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p~=lp and isAimEnemy(p) and p.Character then
            local ch=p.Character; local h=ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local pt=ch:FindFirstChild(aimbotBone) or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); local rt=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if pt and h and h.Health>0 and rt then

                local sp,on=cam:WorldToScreenPoint(pt.Position)

local function getBox(char)
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return nil end
    local rSP = cam:WorldToScreenPoint(root.Position)
    if rSP.Z < 0.5 then return nil end  -- behind camera

    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")

    -- Sample multiple world points and project to screen
    -- This handles any camera angle and avoids Y-inversion bugs
    local pts = {
        root.Position + Vector3.new( 0,  -3.2, 0),  -- feet
        root.Position + Vector3.new( 0,   0,   0),  -- hip/center
        root.Position + Vector3.new( 0.8, 0,   0),  -- right shoulder
        root.Position + Vector3.new(-0.8, 0,   0),  -- left shoulder
    }
    if head then
        table.insert(pts, head.Position + Vector3.new(0, head.Size.Y/2 + 0.15, 0)) -- head top
        table.insert(pts, head.Position)                                              -- head center
    else
        table.insert(pts, root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0))                   -- estimated head
    end

    local minX, minY =  math.huge,  math.huge
    local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
    local any = false

    for _, p in ipairs(pts) do
        local sp = cam:WorldToScreenPoint(p)
        if sp.Z > 0.1 then
            any = true
            if sp.X < minX then minX = sp.X end
            if sp.X > maxX then maxX = sp.X end
            if sp.Y < minY then minY = sp.Y end
            if sp.Y > maxY then maxY = sp.Y end
        end
    end

    if not any then return nil end

    local bh = maxY - minY
    if bh < 8 then return nil end

    -- Widen box horizontally — point sampling underestimates width
    local cx  = (minX + maxX) * 0.5
    local estW = math.max(maxX - minX, bh * 0.45)
    minX = cx - estW / 2
    maxX = cx + estW / 2

    local hum  = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hp   = hum and hum.Health or 0
    local mhp  = hum and math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1) or 1
    local dist = myRoot and math.floor((myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude) or 0

    -- 4px padding around the sampled bounds
    return {
        x   = minX - 4,
        y   = minY - 4,
        w   = (maxX - minX) + 8,
        h   = bh + 8,
        cx  = cx,
        dist= dist,
        hp  = hp, mhp = mhp, hpr = hp / mhp
    }
end
